question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing left back, Claire is playing cheerleader, Dave is playing right back, Eve is playing benchwarmer, Fred is playing sweeper, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Fred and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Dave trade positions. Then, Eve and Bob trade positions. Then, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Eve and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Eve is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) left back
(C) cheerleader
(D) right back
(E) benchwarmer
(F) sweeper
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Positions in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: striker, left back, cheerleader, right back, benchwarmer, sweeper, goalkeeper
1. Bob ↔ Gertrude: striker, goalkeeper, cheerleader, right back, benchwarmer, sweeper, left back
2. Eve ↔ Fred: striker, goalkeeper, cheerleader, right back, sweeper, benchwarmer, left back
3. Fred ↔ Dave: striker, goalkeeper, cheerleader, benchwarmer, sweeper, right back, left back
4. Claire ↔ Dave: striker, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, cheerleader, sweeper, right back, left back
5. Eve ↔ Bob: striker, sweeper, benchwarmer, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right back, left back
6. Alice ↔ Gertrude: left back, sweeper, benchwarmer, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right back, striker
7. Eve ↔ Dave: left back, sweeper, benchwarmer, goalkeeper, cheerleader, right back, striker
Eve is playing cheerleader, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
